target: every alias call_openrouter.sh ships must have a committed price — an unpriced default means the bulk tier refuses out of the box
cmd: for A in kimi minimax mimo; do OUT=$(cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-small.json" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_openrouter.sh" --model "$A" 2>/dev/null); S=$(echo "$OUT" | jq -r .status); if [ "$S" = "blocked" ]; then echo "refused-$A"; else echo "allowed-$A"; fi; done
_note: Markers are 'allowed-' / 'refused-', deliberately NOT 'priced'/'UNPRICED': must_find runs grep -qiF, which is case-INSENSITIVE, so 'UNPRICED:mimo' would satisfy a needle of 'priced:mimo' and the case would pass on exactly the failure it exists to catch. Neither marker is a substring of the other in any case folding.
